records.issue_text: removeMember in group.js calls findMembers with a stale user_count, so removing the last member of the last page leaves the admin UI on an empty page (e.g. blank list labeled 2/2) until manually navigating back
records.rationale: The finding’s claimed mechanism (stale `group.user_count` causing pagination `meta.total`/UI `totalPages` drift) is contradicted by the diff: `GroupsController#members` computes `total = group.users.count` and returns it as `meta: { total: total, ... }`, and the client `findMembers()` sets `user_count: result.meta.total`. So pagination totals come from a fresh `count`, not a persisted counter cache. Even if `group.users.delete(user_id)` didn’t update a counter cache, the pagination/meta used by the UI is derived from `group.users.count`, not `group.user_count`. | The described pagination drift
